claims.claim: The full-state conditional bit entropy c_N(t) converges to c(t) at fixed positive lags, also for t_N->t>0. No Markov bit or arbitrary L2 representative is assumed.
c(t)=C_bit sqrt(t)+o(sqrt(t)); the coefficient is an explicit finite positive Gaussian-threshold entropy integral. This is not the exact observed entropy-rate coefficient.
Given finite-H stationary source joinings in the critical comparison clock have the stated positive error floor; its bound function scales as C_bit^2/(4H log H), not as an achievable optimum.
Actual late-iid binary blocks satisfy the displayed Fano/prefix/clock/TV budget. Finite KS alone supplies no finite-block bound without initial information.

For M_N=N^2 transitions (N^2+1 bits) in actual-parent records, every deterministic source with at most12^N complete initial states has a nonvanishing mean bit-error floor. No stationary source joining or KS premise is needed. Richer initial-information carriers are not excluded.
